text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, this should be far enough…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship! You won't escape me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You're still following me?! You're as tenacious as a komodo dragon!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Very well! I have my own countermeasures… Activating frilled lizard mode! You'll never catch me now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Eat my dust!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… You were just standing there watching?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I could have used some help apprehending that hooligan…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …It's not your fault. I'm just venting. My bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Gold Ship sure is something else though. As a member of the student council, I can't allow her pranks to go unchecked…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But trying to catch a student running wild is quite the task when I can only use sixty percent of my full speed.
choice_data_list: Going all out isn't in the cards, huh?
Going all out isn't in the cards, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course it isn't. The law stipulates that Umamusume aren't allowed to run at full speed outside of designated areas.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We're capable of reaching speeds in excess of fifty kilometers per hour. Were we to run into someone or something, the damage caused would be catastrophic.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Still, it's quite frustrating seeing her slip out of my grasp like that…
choice_data_list: Why don't we get some help?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Still, it's quite frustrating seeing her slip out of my grasp like that…
choice_data_list: Why don't we get some help?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are you right in the head? I couldn't catch her running at sixty percent speed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: With your legs, even running at full tilt, you wouldn't be able to so much as brush your fingertips against the tip of her tail.
choice_data_list: We'll come up with a plan.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A plan, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well. If you have a countermeasure in mind, I'd be happy to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove and I come up with various strategies to capture Gold Ship, and soon enough…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's the deal with you guys?! Are you outta your heads?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Didn't your momma ever teach you that it's lame to ambush in tag?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: My mother and I had no such rule when we used to play racewalk tag!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you used to play some kinda special-rules tag with your mom? I gotta hear all about this!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're in big trouble when we get back to the academy, you know. I hope you're ready.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You can't press charges when there ain't no crime! Heeelp! The Empress has gone rogue! It's an autocracy over heeere!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Enough with your nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she doesn't make it easy, we manage to apprehend the runaway Golshi in the end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: An ally? We're dealing with Gold Ship here. I doubt we'd find anybody up to the—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Actually…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There just might be someone capable of controlling Gold Ship's unfathomable comings and goings!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So, like, what is it you need exactly?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll explain later. Just wait there.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Howdy-do, Jordan! Hoo boy, I wanna smack that back of yours more than ever today!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Not cool! Where did you even come from?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That was perfect, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hold the phone—Air Groove? Are you telling me this was a trap?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed it was. And now I have you! Time to answer for your crimes!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: My life is flashing before my eyes! See you on the other side, folks…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Everyone needs to just, like, hold the phone for a sec…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I have literally zero idea what's going on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For some reason, I end up having to calm Tosen Jordan down. As for Air Groove…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After another brief chase, she finally manages to apprehend Gold Ship once and for all.
